INSTRUCTIONS TO THE TEACHER
 (i) This assessment consists of three parts: PART I: Performing Arts, PART II: Sports, and
 PART III: Visual Arts.
 (ii) Each part contains various tasks that you need to complete. Follow the instructions for each
 task carefully.
 (iii) Each part carries 20marks.
 (iv) The tasks should be done in class or within the school compound during the term.
 (v) Read through the scoring rubrics before beginning the assessment to understand what will
 be expected of the final work. [the rubric can be printed, written out on the board or
 projected].
 (vi) All tasks must be completed and submitted by 31st July2025
 (vii) All materials should be improvised where applicable.
 (viii) An assessment score sheet is attached to record the marks before uploading in the KNEC
 CBA portal. A copy of the score sheet should be signed stamped and kept in safe custody
 for reference.
